answer: Each identity posts a 70-credit bond and registers its funding vertex in a public graph; auditors cluster shared vertices into one island. Each confirmed fake strikes its island, doubling the next bond: 70 at first, 71,680 after ten strikes. Fresh islands to reset strikes still lock 70 each and delay nectar one clean epoch, so 1,000 islands lock 70,000 and earn nothing early. A rented vertex fails: auditors merge islands by collateral origin, so the strike follows it. An honest identity pays 70 once and collects nectar after one clean epoch.
